imprint.note: The founder chooses the imprint and pen name. Check that neither is someone else's trademark or a real author's name.

goal.definition: Royalties the founder has confirmed in the KDP reports for one calendar month, minus ads, covers, ISBNs and other costs.

killCriteria.note: Below this after 90 days live, or reviews showing the listing over-promised: rethink or stop the series.

aiNotice: This book was written with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and edited by people before publication.

defaults.ebookPriceRange: 2.99 to 9.99 USD (the range Amazon has used for its 70% royalty option; confirm on KDP before pricing)
